title: Best Press Release Writers (2026): How to Hire One
description: How to hire a press release writer: what to include, how to brief your news, distribution, what drives the price and the red flags.
intro: A press release announces real news, such as a launch, funding, partnership or event, in a format journalists can use quickly. A good writer finds the newsworthy angle and presents the facts clearly. Press releases disappoint when there is no real news, when distribution is sold as guaranteed media coverage, or when quotes sound like advertising. This guide helps you set realistic expectations.

faq.a: Something new and relevant to a specific audience: a launch, a notable hire, funding, research findings, an award or a local event. If it would only interest you and your team, it is probably not news.

Sometimes. Distribution services send releases to news wires and websites. Being published on a wire is not the same as a journalist writing a story about you. Ask exactly where the release will appear.
No. Journalists decide what to cover. Be careful with offers that promise features in major outlets; they may be paid placements or misleading.

faq.q: What should be in a press release?
faq.a: A clear headline, the key facts in the first paragraph, supporting details, a quote, background about your company and contact details.
Often that works better than mass distribution. A short, personal email to a relevant journalist, with the release attached, can be more effective.
